Exactly two coherent arm chains and natural five-finger hands per person. Furniture contact physically plausible. Faces visible in natural three-quarter working poses, candid curiosity or warm dry humor, no camera gaze. Every screen must face its actual operator, camera sharing the same readable side. Put the physical monitor at the side of the composition and all characters in FRONT of its screen, not behind it. All text and lines share its perspective and foreshortening. Demir alone sits LEFT at a bridge desk, both hands naturally typing on a low keyboard. He leans slightly toward a physical monitor at far RIGHT, focused and pleasantly curious. Its front faces diagonally left toward him and camera. Header "One tensor axis". Exact array on two lines: "[2, 20, 5, 8, 3, 18," and "7, 8, 4, 16, 6, 9]". Beneath: "tf.tensor(streamValues)", then "shape: [12]". Footer "Order comes from the archive header". Remove tablet and paper, no presenting gesture. Show believable seated pelvis and desk clearance. cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic.
